notes_zh:
- **修复** 开机自启动后，状态栏「主管理器 / 设置 / 自动化规则」点击无响应的问题（#66，感谢 @Zxxxxxl @miniers @ghostman-git 的反馈）
- **新增** 「导出诊断日志」（设置 → 通用）
notes_en:
- **Fix** Status-bar "Manager / Settings / Automation rules" not responding when the app was launched at login (#66, thanks @Zxxxxxl @miniers @ghostman-git for the reports)
- **New** "Export Diagnostic Log" (Settings → General)

beta.notes_zh:
- **新增** 图片 OCR 支持识别为 Markdown：自动识别段落、列表和表格并转为 Markdown 格式，需 macOS 26，旧系统自动回退为普通文本识别（#67，感谢 @bingoohuang 的贡献）
- **新增** 图片 OCR 设置独立成页，后台扫描支持随时停止
- **优化** OCR 识别文本在快捷面板和详情页完整显示（原先超长会被截断），长文本渲染开销大幅降低
- **优化** 列表点选时的 CPU 占用
- **修复** 设置窗口标题显示为原始键名的问题
- **修复** 主窗口侧边栏未延伸到标题栏顶部的问题
beta.notes_en:
- **New** Image OCR can now recognize layout as Markdown: paragraphs, lists, and tables are converted to Markdown automatically. Requires macOS 26; older systems fall back to plain-text recognition (#67, thanks @bingoohuang for the contribution)
- **New** Image OCR settings moved to a dedicated pane; the background scan can now be stopped at any time
- **Improve** Recognized text is shown in full in the quick panel and detail view (previously truncated when long), with much lower rendering cost for long text
- **Improve** Reduced CPU usage when clicking through list items
- **Fix** Settings window title showing a raw localization key
- **Fix** Main window sidebar not extending to the top of the title bar
